windows_terms.Task Scheduler: Use the official localized Windows name when one exists; otherwise keep Task Scheduler.

ja.Task Scheduler: タスク スケジューラ

locales.de: Informal du/dein. Microsoft German Localization Style Guide §4.1.14 leaves the form to product guidance, so this glossary's informal default applies. Guide index: https://learn.microsoft.com/globalization/reference/microsoft-style-guides
locales.es: Informal tú. Microsoft Spanish Neutral Localization Style Guide §3.3. Guide index: https://learn.microsoft.com/globalization/reference/microsoft-style-guides
locales.fr: Formal vous, as prescribed by Microsoft French (France) Localization Style Guide §4.1.13. https://download.microsoft.com/download/3b118cfd-a071-48aa-8c01-b49bc14fd38c/fra-fra-StyleGuide.pdf
locales.it: Informal tu. Microsoft Italian Localization Style Guide §§2.1, 2.2.1, 2.2.4. https://download.microsoft.com/download/f/f/7/ff70427c-1f7e-429f-96be-724d2e49cd47/ita-ita-StyleGuide.pdf
locales.pt-BR: Informal você; leave the pronoun out where natural. Microsoft Portuguese (Brazil) Localization Style Guide §4.1.11. https://download.microsoft.com/download/8/e/3/8e349e32-9eb9-4b63-9909-7586b94a24dd/por-bra-StyleGuide.pdf
locales.ja: Polite です/ます, してください for instructions, no second-person pronoun. Microsoft Japanese Localization Style Guide §§2.1.3, 4.1.8, 4.2. https://download.microsoft.com/download/191bd918-cf6a-4576-95e1-a9d40a6b7c60/jpn-jpn-StyleGuide.pdf
locales.zh-Hans: Informal 你; leave the pronoun out where natural. Microsoft Simplified Chinese Localization Style Guide §4.1.12. https://download.microsoft.com/download/1/5/9/159cb91c-b61b-4385-97ca-80ccc7ff1fa0/zho-chn-StyleGuide.pdf
locales.ar: Informal singular second person in Modern Standard Arabic. Microsoft Arabic Localization Style Guide §§2.1, 2.2.1. https://download.microsoft.com/download/5/6/d/56d1774f-ac3f-4ad9-80af-a6dfd5df419d/ara-sau-StyleGuide.pdf

form_of_address.guidance: Address one person informally. Add a locale-specific decision here if its usual app voice needs another form. Do not change brand names to suit grammar.

voice: Plain, short and friendly. Errors say what happened and what to do next. Keep technical detail out of the main message. Keep placeholders unchanged.
